name: blockchain
description: Dominio BLOCKCHAIN (hashing, base58/base32/RLP/varint, indirizzi ETH/BTC, BIP39/BIP32, firma secp256k1, difficolta' di blocco, ABI EVM) via FFI. Sorgenti canonici in gmbsuite/gmbblockchain, copia self-contained qui.

ffi.declareExample: DECLARE FUNCTION KECCAK256 LIB "gmbblockchain" ALIAS "ofx_bc_keccak256" (data() AS BYTE, out() AS BYTE) AS LONG

nativeRequirements.libcrypto: >=3.0 (OpenSSL 3; brew install openssl@3). Non e' un pacchetto del package manager: la lib e' linkata a runtime (ffi.link = -lcrypto).
